prerequisites: Complete mourner disguise from Part I
route: Arianwyn, Mourner HQ, tunnel and corpse journal
Chip black crystal and use shortcut rope
Have Eluned replace the shard with a newly made crystal
Return to temple and solve six ordered mirror puzzles
Open death barrier with a death or catalytic talisman/tiara (or Thorgel alternative)
Charge crystal on Death Altar, restore black crystal, report to Arianwyn
resource_assumptions: A trade-enabled route provisionally reserves 70,000 GP for a death talisman, chisel and rope. Market prices must be checked before optimizing purchase timing.

Death/catalytic talismans and tiaras are the direct altar-entry route. Thorgel's 50-item exchange, Runecraft cape and Underground Pass approach are documented alternatives but not falsely made mandatory.

The six dispenser resets and mirror placements use ordered actions and stable completion flags, not a fabricated per-pillar hand-mirror balance. Mirrors and colored crystals are reusable puzzle resources.
A cyan crystal is collected after blue chest, a fractured prism after yellow chest and a blue crystal after cyan chest; exact dispenser states and container quantities need independent review.
Lletya returns consume separate charges from the four-charge teleport crystal acquired in Part I; walking/taxi alternatives are not exhaustively modeled.
